height.label: Height
height.definition: The player's reported standing height, stored in inches.
height.interpretation: A higher size percentile means taller, rather than better athletic performance.

weight.label: Weight
weight.definition: The player's reported body weight in pounds at that observation.
weight.interpretation: A higher size percentile means heavier. Weight can change between events.

handSize.label: Hand size
handSize.definition: The spread-hand span between the ends of the thumb and little finger.
handSize.interpretation: A higher size percentile means a larger hand span, not a grip-strength score.
handSize.sourceLabel: Green Bay Packers: how combine hand size is measured

armLength.label: Arm length
armLength.definition: The testing source's reported length of one arm, distinct from total wingspan.
armLength.interpretation: A higher size percentile means longer reported arms. This is a size measurement.

wingspan.label: Wingspan
wingspan.definition: The distance between fingertips when both arms extend out to the sides.
wingspan.interpretation: A higher size percentile means a wider overall reach across both arms.

fortyYardDash.label: 40-yard dash
fortyYardDash.definition: The elapsed time for a straight-line 40-yard sprint.
fortyYardDash.interpretation: A lower time means faster completion of this sprint.

tenYardSplit.label: 10-yard split
tenYardSplit.definition: The elapsed time to reach 10 yards during the 40-yard sprint.
tenYardSplit.interpretation: A lower time means faster completion of the opening segment.

twentyYardSplit.label: 20-yard split
twentyYardSplit.definition: The elapsed time from the start to 20 yards during the 40-yard sprint.
twentyYardSplit.interpretation: This is cumulative through 20 yards, not the second 10-yard segment.

threeConeDrill.label: 3-cone drill
threeConeDrill.definition: The time for the prescribed turning course around three cones arranged five yards apart in an L.
threeConeDrill.interpretation: A lower time means faster completion of this change-of-direction course.

twentyYardShuttle.label: 20-yard shuttle
twentyYardShuttle.definition: Time for a 5-yard run, a 10-yard reversal, then 5 yards back to the start.
twentyYardShuttle.interpretation: Also called the short shuttle or 5-10-5; lower times mean faster completion.

sixtyYardShuttle.label: 60-yard shuttle
sixtyYardShuttle.definition: Time for 5-, 10-, and 15-yard runs, returning to the start after each.
sixtyYardShuttle.interpretation: Also called the long shuttle; lower times mean faster completion.

verticalJump.label: Vertical jump
verticalJump.definition: Jumping reach minus standing reach, measured after a jump from a stationary start.
verticalJump.interpretation: A higher result means greater measured vertical jump height.
verticalJump.sourceLabel: NFL: how the vertical jump is measured

broadJump.label: Broad jump
broadJump.definition: The horizontal distance covered by a jump from a standing start.
broadJump.interpretation: A higher result means greater measured horizontal jump distance.

benchPress.label: Bench press
benchPress.definition: The number of completed bench-press repetitions with 225 pounds.
benchPress.interpretation: A higher result means more completed repetitions at the same test weight.
benchPress.sourceLabel: NFL: Scouting Combine tests and 225-pound bench press
